messages:
Aisha M: Heads-up: postmortem posted for the delayed usage ingestion affecting token counts on 2026-03-15..16. Need remediations, owners, and invoice correction plan. https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-delayed-ingest
Tom H: Reviewing now. Any rough count on impacted accounts?
Ravi P: Initial ledger scan shows ~65 accounts with missing events, mostly PAYG. Total missing tokens ~2.3M. Will produce exact ledger export by EOD.
Lena C: I'll own customer comms and credit application. Need a CSV with account_id, orig_billed_tokens, corrected_tokens, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd.
Ravi P: I can take the ingestion fix + backfill and generate that CSV. Plan: deploy consumer fix tomorrow morning, run idempotent backfill dry-run on staging, then full backfill. Expect CSV by 2026-03-20.
Tom H: I'll add a monitoring alert for late-arriving event rate and a dashboard panel. PR to monitoring by 2026-03-18. Recommend a 3-week elevated sweep after fix.
Aisha M: Let's lock owners + dates: ingestion backfill + CSV -> Ravi P -> 2026-03-20 EOD; invoice corrections & emails -> Lena C -> 2026-03-23; accounting sign-off -> Tom H -> 2026-03-24.
billing-bot: JIRA-4721 created: "Delayed ingestion: token undercount 2026-03-15..16". Labels: billing, backfill, monitoring. Priority: P2.
Lena C: For comms: two templates — automated small-credit note (<$50) and manual outreach for larger credits. Will draft and share by 3/21.
Ravi P: Quick validation query (staging):
```
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as events, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM delayed_events_staging
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
I'll attach CSV + validation diff to JIRA-4721.
Tom H: Accounting: I'll prepare the memo and threshold guidance once CSV is attached. Also will coordinate with legal for wording.
Aisha M: Status check scheduled 2026-03-21 11am PT in #finance. If any blockers pop up, escalate to me. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Ravi P: Starting the staging dry-run now, will post short results in the ticket when done.
